title: When Star Harbor Shook
synopsis: The Star One launch is delayed briefly by a sensor check, then carries all six travelers into Earth orbit over the sea.
continuity_state: Before: Scout is on the Moon, crew rocket is on pad, six people/animals trained; no crewed launch yet. After: All six have safely launched in Star One and reached the planned Earth orbit; ground teams continue monitoring.
